scripts.documentation:
# Nickname Editor

This script allows you to edit a Pokémon's nickname.To use this script, simply specify the party slot (starting from 0), of the Pokémon who's trainer name you want to change.

## Technical Details

NameInPoke is the intended script command to change a pokémon's nickname. WipeFadeStart is called after the code to reset the screen after the code. Otherwise the screen remains black and it can be annoying to open a menu to graphic reload.
